checks.name: original vault source + deployed settings + production immutables = production runtime code hash
CODE_DELAY is 7 days and HANDOVER_TTL 1 day in the original bytecode
sha256(SNP launch measurement 70aadff5…) = fbe2f581… (the vault's measurement field)
genesis (original code set = [the running image's measurement]) succeeds
after genesis: running code active at genesis time, corrected code NOT in the set
a handover to a machine running the corrected code is refused before any code proposal
proposeCode with no approvals: Weight(0,1)
proposeCode approved by a machine outside the epoch: NotMachine()
the member's HANDOVER signature (what the original daemon can sign) is not a code approval: BadSignature()
a code approval for another epoch: BadSignature()
proposeCode by the current machine over the codeDigest: activeAt = block.timestamp + 604800 exactly
the same approval cannot be replayed (already proposed): BadSignature()
handover to the corrected code at activeAt - 1: reverted
handover to [original machine, corrected machine] at activeAt: accepted
pending epoch 2: both Enclave-paid machines = ONE seat, t 1, W 1, expires after 1 day
after deal + both acks: epoch 2 active; the original machine is still a member
removeCode (same weight) is immediate
after removal the pending handover cannot activate: the final ack reverts BadCode()
the committee stays at epoch 1 (the old machine keeps serving)
re-proposing the SAME measurement in the same epoch is impossible (single-use digest): BadSignature()
production add digest is deterministic and differs from the removal digest

production.note: A valid call needs approvers=[0xf0f8078459c051a89197fac73ff689c6df96506a] and approvals=[a 65-byte low-s EIP-191 signature by that TEE identity over codeDigestAdd]. The running image has no code that signs this digest.
